echoParts: But God shows his love for us
in that while we were still sinners
verseText: But God shows his love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
meaning: The cross of Jesus shows us exactly how much God loves us. Jesus was willing to suffer the worst even though we were sinners.
